client.text:
Hello Dipali ji. I'm sorry, but I can't file an Old Age Pension application for you right now. The application window closed on 01/10/2026 at 00:00 IST, and the portal isn't accepting new applications.

The scheme pays Rs 250 a month to residents of Purvanchal aged 60 or above. The age proof can be a birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID. I don't have information on when the next window will open, so please check with the Borgaon block office, which covers Udaypur village, for the next application period.

If you have a family member or helper who has a phone, they can check the Sewa Setu portal for updates on when applications reopen. I can also help with checking an existing application if one was filed earlier.

client.text:
I'm sorry, Dipali ji. I don't know when the window will open again, and I can't hold your details to send them later. I can only file while the window is open.

Here's what you can do now:

- **Ask the Borgaon block office** (Udaypur is in Borgaon block) when the next application period starts. They can also tell you whether anything needs to be done before then.
- **Keep your papers ready** so you can apply quickly when it opens:
  - Your age proof: birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Voter ID
  - Your full name and date of birth
  - Your bank account number and IFSC code
- **Keep a phone number that you can check** for updates, since the application's status and messages go to that number.

If you had already filed an application before the deadline, I can check its status for you. Would you like me to do that? If so, please tell me the mobile number you used.
